For `GET /v1/workflows/deployments/{name}`:

- Required path parameter: `name` — the deployment name.
- Required request authentication: an API key in the `Authorization: Bearer ...` header.
- Optional query parameter: `workflow_name` — limits/scopes the reported serving status to the specified workflow. Omit it to get status for the deployment generally.

No request body is required. [`GET /v1/workflows/deployments/{name}` documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/workflows/deployments)
